prompt:
Importing the bank export loses quote characters in descriptions. A row like

    2026-03-05,"Invoice ""Q3-17"", net 30",ACC-0001,ACC-0300,120.00,USD

ends up with the description `Invoice Q3-17, net 30` instead of `Invoice "Q3-17", net 30`.
The export follows the usual CSV convention for quotes inside quoted fields.
